Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that option C (cold temperatures) was the most supported answer, despite earlier evidence from credible sources (e.g., NOAA, Britannica) indicating that prevailing onshore winds are more likely to result in heavier rainfall due to uplift and cloud formation along sea-breeze fronts. This misinterpretation of the dominant effect of onshore winds led to a shift in focus away from the correct answer (A: heavier rainfall) to an alternative (C: cold temperatures).
